threads.body: [General] `createProducerInstrumenter` injects through `MapSetter` during `instrumenter.start(...)`, and that setter calls `envelope.getProperties().put(...)`. A default RocketMQ `Message` has no initialized property map, so an instrumented collection send can throw before reaching the producer. Initialize this synthetic envelope's properties (or otherwise prevent propagation into the envelope) before starting the instrumenter.

replies.body:
No code change.

The synthetic envelope already has initialized properties when propagation runs: RocketMqProducerWrapper.java:95-97 constructs it and invokes setWaitStoreMsgOK; RocketMQ 4.8.0 Message.java:160-161 calls putProperty, whose lines 67-72 allocate a HashMap when properties is null. This precedes instrumenter.start at wrapper lines 111-114 and MapSetter.set at lines 23-27. Existing all-overload propagation and uninitialized-message tests passed on the unchanged frozen head and again after the assertion-only cleanup. No extra property initialization or production change is warranted.
